checks.name: fixed candidate SHA and clean pre-QA tree
dated FX conversion and original CNY

details.inventory: The sitemap contains 34 unique public URLs: 14 model profiles, eight binary comparison pages, the fixed three-model comparison, /benchmarks, and the remaining contracted public pages. Every sitemap URL returned 200 locally.
details.metadata: All 34 sitemap pages have unique Title and H1 values and a self-canonical URL.
details.qwen4: The model profile and its GPT-5.2 comparison both exist and link back. Both visibly state the 2026-11-25 retirement boundary, Token Plan-only access and no pay-as-you-go price.
details.pricing: The pricing page cites and dates the Fed H.10 6.676 CNY/USD snapshot and keeps original CNY values. DeepSeek-V3.2, Kimi K2.5 and MiniMax M2.1 use explicit unknown exact-model hosted pricing language rather than successor prices.
details.comparisonEvidence: No unsupported direct score was added. Pages lacking one common exact-version harness explicitly state that no directly comparable result is available.
details.links: Focused rendered pages contained no duplicate source URL. More comparisons contains only comparison links; benchmarks are separately labelled. New comparisons link their participating models, model pages link back, and /benchmarks reaches CursorBench and BrowseComp.
details.roadmap: docs/PAIRVU_MODEL_CONTENT_ROADMAP.md defines positioning and evidence rules, at least 20 sourced models, one reasonable comparison inbound link per model, an 80% per-batch GSC indexing gate without concentrated canonical/soft-404 failures, Qwen4 retirement handling, and weekly/monthly observation cadence.
details.regression: Targeted checks preserved 410 for /guides in both forms, single-hop redirects for /examples and /checks, unknown 404, and /api/health 200. The unchanged complete PIVOT-02 production legacy matrix was not redundantly rerun.

limitations: Fixed-candidate local acceptance only. Production, GSC, indexing, rankings, authenticated journeys, payment, Stripe and customer data were not exercised or claimed.
cleanup: The local server was stopped. No account, payment, customer-data, GSC, production, commit, push or deployment operation was performed.
